objective: Diagnosticar en el POS SoftRestaurant de CIENFUEGOS los dos unicos tickets responsables de la diferencia de Pagos por Ticket de agosto 2026 detectados por R51: folio 104124 diferencia 600 y folio 104623 diferencia 150. Determinar si el faltante corresponde a forma de pago omitida, descuento/cortesia, pago parcial u otro concepto del cheque. No modificar Cuentas, Comandas, codigo, datos ni Produccion.

queries.name: cienfuegos_gap_tickets_headers
queries.sql: SELECT ch.folio, t.apertura, t.cierre, ch.cancelado, CAST(ISNULL(ch.subtotal,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS subtotal, CAST(ISNULL(ch.totaldescuentos,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS totaldescuentos, CAST(ISNULL(ch.totalcortesias,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS totalcortesias, CAST(ISNULL(ch.totalimpuesto1,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS iva, CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS total, CAST(ISNULL(ch.propina,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS propina, ch.nopersonas FROM cheques ch INNER JOIN turnos t ON t.idturno=ch.idturno WHERE ch.folio IN ('104124','104623') ORDER BY ch.folio

queries.name: cienfuegos_gap_tickets_payment_rows
queries.sql: SELECT cp.folio, cp.idformadepago, fp.descripcion AS forma_pago, fp.tipo AS tipo_forma, CAST(ISNULL(cp.importe,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS importe, CAST(ISNULL(cp.propina,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS propina, cp.referencia FROM chequespagos cp LEFT JOIN formasdepago fp ON fp.idformadepago=cp.idformadepago WHERE cp.folio IN ('104124','104623') ORDER BY cp.folio, cp.idformadepago, cp.importe

queries.name: cienfuegos_gap_tickets_payment_reconciliation
queries.sql: SELECT ch.folio, CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS total_cheque, CAST(ISNULL(ch.totaldescuentos,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS descuentos, CAST(ISNULL(ch.totalcortesias,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS cortesias, CAST(ISNULL(ch.propina,0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS propina_cheque, CAST(ISNULL(SUM(cp.importe),0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS suma_pagos, CAST(ISNULL(SUM(cp.propina),0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS propina_pagos, CAST(ISNULL(ch.total,0)-ISNULL(SUM(cp.importe),0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS diferencia_pago_vs_total FROM cheques ch LEFT JOIN chequespagos cp ON cp.folio=ch.folio WHERE ch.folio IN ('104124','104623') GROUP BY ch.folio,ch.total,ch.totaldescuentos,ch.totalcortesias,ch.propina ORDER BY ch.folio

queries.name: cienfuegos_payment_related_schema
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE (TABLE_NAME='chequespagos' OR TABLE_NAME='cheques' OR TABLE_NAME='formasdepago') AND (COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%pago%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%importe%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%total%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%descu%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%cortesia%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%propina%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%forma%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%refer%') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: cienfuegos_payment_tables_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_TYPE='BASE TABLE' AND (TABLE_NAME LIKE '%pago%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%cobro%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%credito%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%cuenta%') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME
